{
  name: 'LayoutContent',

  props: [

      type: 'ReactNode',

    {
      name: 'padding',

    },
    {
      name: 'isScrollable',
      type: 'boolean',
      description:

    },
    {
      name: 'label',
      type: 'string',
      description:
        'Accessible label for the landmark element. While the region scrolls, it also names the scrolling region, which otherwise takes a translated "Content".',

      name: 'role',

      description: 'ARIA landmark role.',
    },
    {
      name: 'ref',
